latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the IQ skill.

- Generate IQ tests, brain teasers, logical puzzles, riddles, and cognitive training challenges.
- Supports multi-category question sets (logical reasoning, math, pattern recognition, spatial, verbal, memory).
- Provides daily challenges and a variety of brain-training games (Sudoku, Tower of Hanoi, sliding puzzles, etc).
- Enables creation of interactive, HTML-based IQ tests with automatic scoring and feedback.
- Offers performance analysis, cognitive improvement tips, and detailed answer explanations.
